nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the current contract owner, set in the Owned constructor from msg.sender and consumed by the onlyOwner modifier.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer (transferOwnership / acceptOwnership).
SkunkDog.symbol: public token symbol, written once in the constructor to 'SKNKDOG'.
SkunkDog.name: public token name, written once in the constructor to 'SkunkDog'.
SkunkDog.decimals: public token decimals, written once in the constructor to 18.
SkunkDog._totalSupply: total token supply; assigned in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
SkunkDog.balances: mapping(address => uint) of token balances, the primary value store written by transfer and transferFrom.
SkunkDog.allowed: nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of ERC20 allowances, written by approve/approveAndCall and by transferFrom.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): checked addition with require(c >= a) overflow guard.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): checked subtraction with require(b <= a) underflow guard.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): multiplication with require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow guard.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): division with require(b > 0) divide-by-zero guard.
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender, delegating full control to the deployer.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner): onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, then promotes newOwner to owner and clears newOwner.
SkunkDog constructor: initializes symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply and mints the whole supply to a hard-coded address.
SkunkDog.totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using raw unchecked subtraction instead of SafeMath.
SkunkDog.balanceOf(address tokenOwner): constant view returning balances[tokenOwner].
SkunkDog.transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender to `to` using safeSub/safeAdd.
SkunkDog.approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no zero-first check (documented double-spend allowance risk).
SkunkDog.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): spends allowance and moves balances on behalf of `from`.
SkunkDog.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): constant view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
SkunkDog.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance and then calls spender.receiveApproval, an external call to an arbitrary caller-supplied contract.
SkunkDog fallback function: payable but unconditionally reverts, refusing all ETH.
SkunkDog.transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens): onlyOwner sweep that performs an external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership assignment, authorization checks, and as the effective `from` account of transfers.
Raw unchecked subtraction `_totalSupply - balances[address(0)]` in totalSupply(), bypassing SafeMath and theoretically underflow-prone.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an attacker-supplied address, with no reentrancy guard and a state write before the call.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary contract address with no reentrancy protection and unchecked return value.
